## Highlights

- Honor the documented JSON acknowledgement mode across task/group/chain operations, alert acknowledgement, notification removal and local service/desktop actions. Preserve human text and return output-write errors without replaying operations (#445).
- Reject unexpected daemon operands before loading configuration or creating state (#446).
- Strengthen CLI evaluation of selected structured output, retaining exact SMTP task/run/delivery/receiver correlation and separate human fixtures (#447).
- Improve pairing, timestamp, graph-cycle and missing-desktop recovery guidance; make the wrong-daemon fixture reach its intended remote identity check (#448, #449, #450).
- Include S136-S138 maintainer check efficiency, canonical command regression coverage and opt-in pre-entry PowerShell runtime-event diagnostics. The runtime-event query is integrated in source test fixtures; it is not a new installed CLI mode.
- Retain current storage, public scheduling capabilities, authentication and opt-in remote/MCP boundaries. Original #355/#356 causal outcomes remain unresolved. The S139 assessment records actual Windows/WSL, frontend and native-feasibility observations separately; unavailable native observations are not implied by automated passes.

Read the [full changelog](https://github.com/shruggietech/go-schedule/blob/v2.0.2/CHANGELOG.md#202---2026-11-08) for every change.
